description: Header file defining the DeviceDescriptor class and related classes for managing audio device descriptors in Android's audio policy framework.

classes.name: DeviceDescriptor
classes.description: Represents an audio device with properties like type, address, and supported profiles, and provides methods for configuration and port management.

classes.name: DeviceVector
classes.description: A sorted collection of DeviceDescriptor objects with methods for managing device lists, filtering, and comparison.

methods.name: addAudioProfile
methods.description: Adds an audio profile to the device and sorts the profiles.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable tag name of the device.

methods.name: getEncodedFormat
methods.description: Returns the current encoded audio format.

methods.name: setEncodedFormat
methods.description: Sets the encoded audio format.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this device descriptor is equal to another.

methods.name: hasCurrentEncodedFormat
methods.description: Checks if the device has a current encoded format.

methods.name: setDynamic
methods.description: Marks the device as dynamic.

methods.name: isDynamic
methods.description: Checks if the device is dynamic.

methods.name: getPolicyAudioPort
methods.description: Returns the device as a PolicyAudioPort.

methods.name: applyAudioPortConfig
methods.description: Applies an audio port configuration to the device.

methods.name: toAudioPortConfig
methods.description: Converts device info to an audio port configuration.

methods.name: asAudioPort
methods.description: Returns the device as an AudioPort.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches the device to a hardware module.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the device from its hardware module.

methods.name: toAudioPort
methods.description: Converts device info to an audio port structure.

methods.name: toAudioPortInternal
methods.description: Internal helper to convert device info to specific audio port types.

methods.name: importAudioPortAndPickAudioProfile
methods.description: Imports audio port info and selects an audio profile.

methods.name: setEncapsulationInfoFromHal
methods.description: Sets encapsulation info from hardware abstraction layer.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs device info for debugging.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a device descriptor to the collection.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a device descriptor from the collection.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of a device descriptor.

methods.name: types
methods.description: Returns the set of device types in the collection.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a device matching type, address, and codec.

methods.name: getDevicesFromTypes
methods.description: Retrieves devices matching a set of types.

methods.name: getDevicesFromType
methods.description: Retrieves devices of a specific type.

methods.name: getDeviceFromId
methods.description: Retrieves a device by port handle ID.

methods.name: getDeviceFromTagName
methods.description: Retrieves a device by its tag name.

methods.name: getDevicesFromHwModule
methods.description: Retrieves devices from a hardware module handle.

methods.name: getFirstDevicesFromTypes
methods.description: Retrieves first devices from a list of types.

methods.name: getFirstExistingDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the first existing device from a list of types.

methods.name: getDeviceForOpening
methods.description: Returns the device used to open a stream.

methods.name: getDeviceFromDeviceTypeAddr
methods.description: Retrieves a device matching a specific device type address.

methods.name: getDevicesFromDeviceTypeAddrVec
methods.description: Retrieves devices matching a vector of device type addresses.

methods.name: toTypeAddrVector
methods.description: Converts device list to a vector of device type addresses.

methods.name: replaceDevicesByType
methods.description: Replaces devices of a specific type with a new list.

methods.name: containsDeviceAmongTypes
methods.description: Checks if collection contains devices among specified types.

methods.name: containsDeviceWithType
methods.description: Checks if collection contains devices of a specific type.

methods.name: onlyContainsDevicesWithType
methods.description: Checks if collection contains only devices of a specific type.

methods.name: onlyContainsDevice
methods.description: Checks if collection contains only a specific device.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if collection contains a specific device.

methods.name: containsAtLeastOne
methods.description: Checks if collection contains at least one device from another collection.

methods.name: containsAllDevices
methods.description: Checks if collection contains all devices from another collection.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters devices supported by this collection against another.

methods.name: filterForEngine
methods.description: Filters devices for engine use.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another device vector into this one.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if two DeviceVectors are equal.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two DeviceVectors are not equal.

methods.name: getFirstValidAddress
methods.description: Returns the first valid address among devices.

methods.name: getSupportedProfiles
methods.description: Returns supported audio profiles.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string description of the device vector.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs device vector info for debugging.

methods.name: do_compare
methods.description: Internal comparison function for sorting.

methods.name: refreshTypes
methods.description: Refreshes device type set.

methods.name: refreshAudioProfiles
methods.description: Refreshes supported audio profiles.
